title: Year-view prev/next buttons have a vague, ungrouped aria-label
where: index.html:3553-3557 (.calnav div and its two buttons)
detail: In Year view, the prior/next-year buttons are `aria-label="Previous"` and `aria-label="Next"` with no wrapping group label — contrast with the pay-period stepper right above it (index.html:3457), which wraps identical-looking ‹/› buttons in `role="group" aria-label="Pay period"` and gives the buttons themselves `aria-label="Previous pay period"`/`"Next pay period"`. The Year-view .calnav div has no role or aria-label at all.
failure: A screen-reader user tabbing through the calendar card in Year view reaches a button announced only as "Previous, button" — nothing says it steps by year (versus the pay-period stepper's control, one screen away, which does say what it steps). They have to explore surrounding content to guess what it does.
fix: Label the buttons `aria-label="Previous year"`/`"Next year"` (matching the pattern already used for the pay-period stepper), and/or add `role="group" aria-label="Year"` to the wrapping .calnav div.
